correctness.rationale: The well-defined Bockstein map, five-block anticommutator parameterization, r unit pivots, s-square free beta block, and finite-field rank count together prove the formula uniformly for finite length-two commutative chain rings. The independent brute arithmetic verifier agrees over Z/4, Z/9 and several split dual rings.

value.rationale: The mod-p homology endomorphism is a natural secondary invariant of a square-zero differential; its rank exactly detects torsion in the image invisible to residue Jordan rank. The result gives a full joint classification of labeled square-zero maps by residue type and image module type over all length-two chain rings, with uniform secondary-map fibers and a ring-independence phenomenon, not an arbitrary numeric slice.
